prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent whole-body animation sprite sheet.
Preserve the approved Kicker reference EXACTLY: warm brown skin, black quiff, coral headband, cobalt/lime jacket over ivory shirt, navy cropped trousers, taped bare feet, black gloves and jade/coral spray can. Same body scale and flat lighting, simple restrained blocky pixels. All drawings face right, connected whole anatomy.
Create EIGHT drawings in a strict FOUR column x TWO row equal grid, generous transparent margins, no labels/text/grid/shadows/ground/effects.
Top row: four consecutive full-body spray-tag action frames: (1) lifts the jade spray can from hip; (2) bends knees and lowers the can beside his foot; (3) leans slightly and sweeps the can sideways near ground; (4) stands back up returning can to hip. All four drawings should show the actual hand grasping the same can. Do not draw paint or glyphs, just the body motion. Keep headband and jacket scale consistent.
Bottom row: four consecutive quiet rooftop-perch breathing poses: low stable crouch, both wrapped feet on ground level, one hand lightly braced; subtly rise in breathing; settle; relaxed ready position. Not four copies and no bounce or sudden changes. Do not detach head, hands, legs or torso. Preserve expressive athlete silhouette. Transparent background.
